newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka NDB sale may give govt 4-5 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka NDB sale may give govt 4-5 bln rupees.

text.p: Sri Lanka's sale of 18.33 million shares in the National Development Bank is likely to raise four to five billion rupees, an official of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC) said on Wednesday.
"We expect net revenue to the government of between four and five billion rupees," said the official, who declined to be identified.
PERC is a government body which oversees privatisations.

The NDB said earlier it would convert 27.5 million debentures held by the government into 18.33 million ordinary shares, increasing the bank's issued capital to 35.83 million 10-rupee ordinary shares, from 17.5 million.
The shares will be offered on the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) in the largest-ever single flotation in Sri Lanka.
